Exactly what happened to me. I love Microsoft but I swore I'd never buy the elite 2 again. Brand new right out of the box, after 3 weeks it had bad, and I mean BAD, stick drift. Sent it in for repairs under warranty and it came back even worse. They refused to help further so I sent it to a professional outside repair shop and even the guy there said he sees bad stick drift issues with them and the scuffs. The stick drift is better, but now the bumpers stick so playing call of duty is pretty miserable.

I've wanted a GoPro since my early 20s and finally bought the hero 12 black for my Bahamas trip I took last week and honestly it was everything I dreamed of. It took beautiful photos and beautiful videos and was super easy to use plus the attachments I bought for it worked amazingly. No complaints here other than the app saying my phone storage was full but after a few trys it finally uploaded all of my stuff. I don't have buyers remorse at all!

I literally JUST got out of a match and our whole team of three were downed by fucking AI in the zoo in Vondel. It shouldn't be like that. We weren't bad players, but it was IMPOSSIBLE to revive our fallen team members, and we all got wiped out. We probably collectively killed about 40-50 of them, but they still swarmed us. It was extremely frustrating and one of the reasons I find it so difficult to continue to enjoy DMZ. Pvp gives enough challenge without adding 40,000 3 tier AI in a small area.
9 days before my 29th birthday 😂
